After bringing up his ninth Test ton off just 135 deliveries on Day 4 of the first Test at the Basin Reserve, Pant became the first Asian wicketkeeper to score a century in all SENA (South Africa, England, New Zealand and Australia) countries.

stories.title: Real Madrid president Florentino Perez promises free streaming of UEFA club matches in India from 2027
stories.summary: The proposed streaming platform will be developed through a partnership involving UEFA and European Football Clubs (EFC). India will be the first market where the new model is tested, with the possibility of it being rolled out in other countries later. Perez made the announcement while addressing Real Madrid members, underlining the potential of the Indian market.

stories.title: Rishabh Pant's ton puts India on top, Bumrah and Prasidh strike as New Zealand close Day 4 on 119/2 in Wellington
stories.summary: India’s dominance continued in the first Test against New Zealand at the Basin Reserve as they enter the final day of the match with a lead of 233 runs and eight wickets away from taking a 1-0 lead in the series.

stories.summary: Punjab Kings had parted ways with their bowling coach James Hopes recently. Mhambrey recently parted ways with MI after a long association with the franchise. stories.title: Alcaraz to face Zverev in ATP Finals title decider
stories.summary: Carlos Alcaraz will face world number one Alexander Zverev for the ATP Finals title after completing a superb comeback victory against Ben Shelton. The indomitable Spaniard recovered from a flat start to outlast Shelton 3-6 6-3 7-6 (7-1) and secure a return to the showpiece, 12 months after losing to Jannik Sinner.

stories.title: IND vs NZ 1st Test: Bossing the Basin! KL Rahul's 13th Test ton, Shubman Gill's 98 put India in command
stories.summary: By stumps on Day 3, India, resuming at 159-1, had surged to 486-4 — a lead of 118 — with Rishabh Pant unbeaten on 55. If Rahul’s 136 off 296 balls, with nine fours and two sixes, laid the foundation, Gill’s 98 off 146 balls, with nine fours and two sixes, provided the impetus.

stories.title: Fox Cricket takes David Warner, Usman Khawaja off air as Sandpapergate row deepens
stories.summary: The Sandpapergate is creating new divisions in Australian cricket, eight years after the ball-tampering scandal erupted on the Test tour to South Africa. Now, Fox Cricket has temporarily taken David Warner and Usman Khawaja off the air. The duo will be rested from commentary in the next few weeks as fresh allegations and counterclaims surface around the 2018 ball-tampering incident.

stories.title: Australia's Chaudhary downs England in tetchy first T20
stories.summary: Unlikely Australia international Nikhil Chaudhary rattled England and was the match-winner in a tense and tetchy final-over victory in the first T20 international in Melbourne. Born in Delhi and a team-mate of India captain Shubman Gill in Indian domestic cricket, Chaudhary only switched to representing Australia after the Covid pandemic meant he got stuck in Brisbane celebrating his 24th birthday.

stories.title: India go on record-breaking spree as Pant, Rahul shine in Wellington Test
stories.summary: Rahul's 136 made him the first Indian opener to score Test hundreds in all four SENA countries. Yashasvi Jaiswal set things up with 85, Devdutt Padikkal added 80 and Shubman Gill fell agonisingly short of a hundred with 98. Pant, meanwhile, smashed 128 to become the first Asian wicketkeeper to score Test centuries in all four SENA countries.

stories.title: Pat Cummins wins Cricket Australia's ‘unanimous support’ to remain Test captain
stories.summary: Cricket Australia threw its "unanimous support" behind Pat Cummins to remain Test captain on Saturday (November 21, 2026), rejecting any suggestion his integrity had been compromised by the lingering "Sandpapergate" scandal. Cummins has been under huge pressure since Usman Khawaja claimed the whole team knew about the plot to alter the ball in a Test at Cape Town in 2018.

stories.title: Satwik-Chirag pair exits Hong Kong Open; Lakshya also bows out
stories.summary: India's challenge ended at the Hong Kong Open Super 500 badminton tournament after the men's doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, and Lakshya Sen lost their respective semifinals on Saturday (November 21, 2026). Satwik and Chirag, the world No. 6 pair, suffered an 18-21, 19-21 loss in a fast-paced match against Malaysia’s eighth-seeded pair of Man Wei Chong and Tee Kai Wun.

stories.title: Verstappen wins extraordinary race as Ferraris collide
stories.summary: F1 Correspondent in Las Vegas Published 22 November 2026, 06:01 GMT Updated 4 minutes ago Red Bull's Max Verstappen won an extraordinary Las Vegas Grand Prix that saw a non-stop battle for the lead for the entire race. The leading group of 10 cars were tied together for the vast majority of the race as the lead constantly changed hands between Verstappen and the Mercedes drivers George Russell and Kimi Antonelli.

stories.title: Indian Blind Cricket Team Slams Pakistan Umpire Over Celebrations After Asia Cup Final
stories.summary: India's blind cricket team had boycotted the trophy presentation ceremony after Pakistan were declared champions despite the final being washed out. CABI has now raised concerns over the umpire's conduct, maintaining that match officials must remain neutral and should not be seen celebrating with either team. “This Pakistani umpire officiated throughout the Asia Cup Cricket for the Blind 2026, yet is seen celebrating with the Pakistan team,” CABI said in a statement.

stories.title: I was too impatient: Lakshya on Hong Kong Open semi-final loss
stories.summary: India’s challenge at the Hong Kong Open Super 500 badminton tournament ended on Saturday after Lakshya Sen as well as the doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty lost their respective semi-finals here. Sen went down 13-21 13-21 to Denmark’s Anders Antonsen, ending the Indian’s unbeaten run, which included two titles at the Hylo Open and Kumamoto Masters Japan over the last two weeks.

stories.title: EPFO’s Systematic Withdrawal Plan: What is the waiting period for final PF withdrawal if unemployed? Explained here
stories.summary: Under the revised framework, eligible EPF members who leave employment and remain unemployed can apply for final settlement after two months instead of waiting for 12 months. The decision, taken on November 19, reverses the change introduced in October 2025, when the waiting period for final PF withdrawal was extended from two months to one year.
